author: ThioJoe
description:
Could Linux ever take over and beat Windows?

There's been a lot more talk about Linux lately, with people talking about switching from Windows because of annoyances in Windows. But could this mean that Linux could actually end up replacing Windows as the standard OS? It would take a lot for sure, but what exactly? That's what I talk about in this video. What could make the average person really switch to Linux.
